# LokaUI
> An open source collection of high quality, accessible, and fully customizable UI components.

## Installation
npx shadcn@latest add @lokaui/<component-name>

## Available Components (24)
- Button: https://lokaui.dev/foundations/button
- Input: https://lokaui.dev/foundations/input
- Badge: https://lokaui.dev/foundations/badge
- Toggle: https://lokaui.dev/foundations/toggle
- Dialog: https://lokaui.dev/overlays/dialog
- Drawer: https://lokaui.dev/overlays/drawer
- Tooltip: https://lokaui.dev/overlays/tooltip
- Popover: https://lokaui.dev/overlays/popover
- Table: https://lokaui.dev/data-display/table
- Card: https://lokaui.dev/data-display/card
- Avatar: https://lokaui.dev/data-display/avatar
- Progress: https://lokaui.dev/data-display/progress
- Tabs: https://lokaui.dev/navigation/tabs
- Breadcrumb: https://lokaui.dev/navigation/breadcrumb
- Sidebar: https://lokaui.dev/navigation/sidebar
- Pagination: https://lokaui.dev/navigation/pagination
- Select: https://lokaui.dev/forms/select
- Checkbox: https://lokaui.dev/forms/checkbox
- Radio: https://lokaui.dev/forms/radio
- Textarea: https://lokaui.dev/forms/textarea
- Toast: https://lokaui.dev/feedback/toast
- Alert: https://lokaui.dev/feedback/alert
- Skeleton: https://lokaui.dev/feedback/skeleton
- Spinner: https://lokaui.dev/feedback/spinner

## Variants
Each component supports multiple variants:
- React: JS-CSS, JS-TW, TS-CSS, TS-TW
- Laravel: HTML-TW (Button only, more coming)
- React Native: RN-TW, RN-StyleSheet (Button only, more coming)
